objects.description: Exit code enum used by the streaming and utility APIs. Values: XXH_OK (0) and XXH_ERROR (nonzero).
Unsigned 32-bit hash value type returned by XXH32 APIs. Under some platforms it may typedef to unsigned int or unsigned long if stdint is unavailable.

Opaque streaming state for the XXH32 algorithm. Allocate with XXH32_createState(), initialize with XXH32_reset(), feed with XXH32_update(), get result with XXH32_digest(), and free with XXH32_freeState(). When XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY (or inlined implementation) is defined, the struct layout is exposed for static allocation, but its fields must not be accessed directly.
Canonical big-endian representation of a 32-bit hash. Use XXH32_canonicalFromHash() to fill and XXH32_hashFromCanonical() to read back a native XXH32_hash_t.
Unsigned 64-bit hash value type returned by XXH64 and XXH3_64bits APIs. May typedef to unsigned long long or unsigned long depending on platform when stdint is unavailable.

Opaque streaming state for the XXH64 algorithm. Allocate with XXH64_createState(), initialize with XXH64_reset(), feed with XXH64_update(), get result with XXH64_digest(), and free with XXH64_freeState(). When XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY (or inlined implementation) is defined, the struct layout is exposed for static allocation, but its fields must not be accessed directly.

objects.definition: typedef struct { unsigned char digest[sizeof(XXH64_hash_t)]; } XXH64_canonical_t;
objects.description: Canonical big-endian representation of a 64-bit hash. Use XXH64_canonicalFromHash() to fill and XXH64_hashFromCanonical() to convert back to native XXH64_hash_t.

Opaque streaming state for the XXH3 family (both 64-bit and 128-bit). Allocate with XXH3_createState(), initialize with XXH3_64bits_reset()/XXH3_128bits_reset or their seeded/secret variants, update with XXH3_64bits_update()/XXH3_128bits_update(), finalize with the corresponding digest, and free with XXH3_freeState(). When XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY (or inlined implementation) is defined, the struct layout and strict 64-byte alignment requirement are exposed for static/stack allocation. Do not access members directly.
128-bit hash value structure returned by XXH3 128-bit APIs and helper XXH128(). Stored as two 64-bit halves (low64, high64). Comparable via XXH128_isEqual() or XXH128_cmp().

objects.definition: typedef struct { unsigned char digest[sizeof(XXH128_hash_t)]; } XXH128_canonical_t;
objects.description: Canonical big-endian representation of a 128-bit hash. Use XXH128_canonicalFromHash() to serialize and XXH128_hashFromCanonical() to deserialize to XXH128_hash_t.

Internal helper enum used in implementation to indicate pointer alignment for optimized memory reads. Not part of the stable public API; exposed because implementation is included in this header when inlining/implementation macros are used.
Internal unsigned 8-bit type alias used within implementation. Aliased to BYTE and U8 when XXH_OLD_NAMES is defined. Not intended for public API consumption.
Internal unsigned 32-bit type alias mapped to XXH32_hash_t. Not part of the stable API.
Internal unsigned 64-bit type alias mapped to XXH64_hash_t. Not part of the stable API.

functions.name: XXH_versionNumber
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_CONSTF unsigned XXH_versionNumber (void);
functions.description: Returns the library’s encoded version number (major*100*100 + minor*100 + release) of the xxHash implementation actually linked at runtime. Useful to check ABI when using a shared library.
requirements: No arguments; callable at any time.

functions.name: XXH32
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH32_hash_t XXH32 (const void* input, size_t length, XXH32_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Single-shot 32-bit xxHash. Computes a 32-bit hash over a contiguous memory block with an optional 32-bit seed.
requirements: If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise the byte range [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the object range must be TriviallyCopyable (bytes accessible as unsigned char).

functions.name: XXH32_createState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_MALLOCF XXH32_state_t* XXH32_createState(void);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new XXH32 streaming state object for incremental hashing.
requirements: Must be freed with XXH32_freeState(); do not free with free().
Returns NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: XXH32_freeState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode  XXH32_freeState(XXH32_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Frees a XXH32_state_t previously allocated by XXH32_createState.
requirements: statePtr must have been allocated by XXH32_createState().
Always returns XXH_OK.

functions.name: XXH32_copyState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH32_copyState(XXH32_state_t* dst_state, const XXH32_state_t* src_state);
functions.description: Copies the full XXH32 streaming state from src_state to dst_state.
requirements: dst_state and src_state must not be NULL.
dst_state and src_state must not overlap.

functions.name: XXH32_reset
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH32_reset  (XXH32_state_t* statePtr, XXH32_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Initializes/resets an XXH32 streaming state with the provided 32-bit seed to begin a new hashing session.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
Call before XXH32_update().
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH32_update
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH32_update (XXH32_state_t* statePtr, const void* input, size_t length);
functions.description: Feeds a chunk of data into the XXH32 streaming state. Can be called repeatedly.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH32_digest
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH32_hash_t XXH32_digest (const XXH32_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Produces the current 32-bit hash from the streaming state without modifying it. You may continue updating after digest.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH32_canonicalFromHash
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH32_canonicalFromHash(XXH32_canonical_t* dst, XXH32_hash_t hash);
functions.description: Converts a native XXH32_hash_t to its big-endian canonical representation for storage or transmission.
requirements: dst must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH32_hashFromCanonical
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH32_hash_t XXH32_hashFromCanonical(const XXH32_canonical_t* src);
functions.description: Converts a big-endian canonical XXH32_canonical_t back to native XXH32_hash_t.
requirements: src must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH64
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH64(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Single-shot 64-bit xxHash. Computes a 64-bit hash over a contiguous memory block with an optional 64-bit seed.
requirements: If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise the byte range [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the object range must be TriviallyCopyable (bytes accessible as unsigned char).

functions.name: XXH64_createState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_MALLOCF XXH64_state_t* XXH64_createState(void);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new XXH64 streaming state object for incremental hashing.
requirements: Must be freed with XXH64_freeState(); do not free with free().
Returns NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: XXH64_freeState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode  XXH64_freeState(XXH64_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Frees a XXH64_state_t previously allocated by XXH64_createState.
requirements: statePtr must have been allocated by XXH64_createState().
Always returns XXH_OK.

functions.name: XXH64_copyState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH64_copyState(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH64_state_t* dst_state, const XXH64_state_t* src_state);
functions.description: Copies the full XXH64 streaming state from src_state to dst_state.
requirements: dst_state and src_state must not be NULL.
dst_state and src_state must not overlap.

functions.name: XXH64_reset
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH64_reset  (XXH_NOESCAPE XXH64_state_t* statePtr, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Initializes/resets an XXH64 streaming state with the provided 64-bit seed to begin a new hashing session.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
Call before XXH64_update().
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH64_update
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH64_update (XXH_NOESCAPE XXH64_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length);
functions.description: Feeds a chunk of data into the XXH64 streaming state. Can be called repeatedly.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH64_digest
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH64_digest (XXH_NOESCAPE const XXH64_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Produces the current 64-bit hash from the streaming state without modifying it. You may continue updating after digest.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH64_canonicalFromHash
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH64_canonicalFromHash(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH64_canonical_t* dst, XXH64_hash_t hash);
functions.description: Converts a native XXH64_hash_t to its big-endian canonical representation for storage or transmission.
requirements: dst must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH64_hashFromCanonical
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH64_hashFromCanonical(XXH_NOESCAPE const XXH64_canonical_t* src);
functions.description: Converts a big-endian canonical XXH64_canonical_t back to native XXH64_hash_t.
requirements: src must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH3_64bits
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH3_64bits(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length);
functions.description: Single-shot unseeded XXH3 64-bit hash using the built-in secret. Optimized for small and large inputs; returns a 64-bit hash.
requirements: If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_withSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH3_64bits_withSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Single-shot seeded XXH3 64-bit hash. Derives an internal secret from the provided 64-bit seed.
requirements: If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_withSecret
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH3_64bits_withSecret(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* data, size_t len, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize);
functions.description: Single-shot XXH3 64-bit hash using a caller-provided custom secret.
requirements: [data, data+len) must be valid and readable (or data may be NULL if len == 0).
secret must not be NULL and must point to high-entropy bytes.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).
The quality of the hash depends on the secret’s entropy; avoid trivial/structured secrets.

functions.name: XXH3_createState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_MALLOCF XXH3_state_t* XXH3_createState(void);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new XXH3 streaming state (suitable for both 64-bit and 128-bit XXH3 streaming). State is 64-byte aligned when created.
requirements: Must be freed with XXH3_freeState(); do not free with free().
Returns NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: XXH3_freeState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_freeState(XXH3_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Frees an XXH3_state_t previously allocated by XXH3_createState.
requirements: statePtr must have been allocated by XXH3_createState().
Always returns XXH_OK.

functions.name: XXH3_copyState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH3_copyState(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* dst_state, XXH_NOESCAPE const XXH3_state_t* src_state);
functions.description: Copies one XXH3 streaming state to another.
requirements: dst_state and src_state must not be NULL.
dst_state and src_state must not overlap.

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_reset
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_64bits_reset(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 64-bit hashing using the default secret (equivalent to XXH3_64bits()).
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.
Call before XXH3_64bits_update().

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_reset_withSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_64bits_reset_withSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 64-bit hashing using a 64-bit seed (equivalent to XXH3_64bits_withSeed()). May generate a custom secret from the seed.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
If seed == 0 behavior is equivalent to XXH3_64bits_reset().
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.
Call before XXH3_64bits_update().

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_reset_withSecret
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_64bits_reset_withSecret(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 64-bit hashing using a caller-provided secret (equivalent to XXH3_64bits_withSecret()). The secret is referenced (not copied).
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
secret must not be NULL and must outlive the entire streaming session.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136) and should have high entropy.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_update
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_64bits_update (XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length);
functions.description: Feeds a chunk of data into an XXH3 64-bit streaming state. Can be called repeatedly.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_digest
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH3_64bits_digest (XXH_NOESCAPE const XXH3_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Returns the current 64-bit XXH3 digest from the streaming state without modifying it. Streaming can continue afterwards.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH3_128bits
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH3_128bits(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* data, size_t len);
functions.description: Single-shot unseeded XXH3 128-bit hash using the built-in secret. Returns a 128-bit result in an XXH128_hash_t struct.
requirements: If len == 0, data may be NULL; otherwise [data, data+len) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_withSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH3_128bits_withSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* data, size_t len, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Single-shot seeded XXH3 128-bit hash. Derives an internal secret from the provided 64-bit seed.
requirements: If len == 0, data may be NULL; otherwise [data, data+len) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_withSecret
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH3_128bits_withSecret(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* data, size_t len, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize);
functions.description: Single-shot XXH3 128-bit hash using a caller-provided custom secret.
requirements: [data, data+len) must be valid and readable (or data may be NULL if len == 0).
secret must not be NULL and must point to high-entropy bytes.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_reset
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_128bits_reset(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 128-bit hashing using the default secret (equivalent to XXH3_128bits()).
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.
Call before XXH3_128bits_update().

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_reset_withSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_128bits_reset_withSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 128-bit hashing using a 64-bit seed (equivalent to XXH3_128bits_withSeed()). May generate a custom secret from the seed.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.
Call before XXH3_128bits_update().

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_reset_withSecret
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_128bits_reset_withSecret(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 128-bit hashing using a caller-provided secret (equivalent to XXH3_128bits_withSecret()). The secret is referenced (not copied).
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
secret must not be NULL and must outlive the streaming session.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136) and should have high entropy.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_update
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_128bits_update (XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length);
functions.description: Feeds a chunk of data into an XXH3 128-bit streaming state. Can be called repeatedly.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
If length == 0, input may be NULL; otherwise [input, input+length) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_digest
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH3_128bits_digest (XXH_NOESCAPE const XXH3_state_t* statePtr);
functions.description: Returns the current 128-bit XXH3 digest from the streaming state without modifying it. Streaming can continue afterwards.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH128_isEqual
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF int XXH128_isEqual(XXH128_hash_t h1, XXH128_hash_t h2);
functions.description: Compares two XXH128_hash_t values for equality.
requirements: None beyond passing two valid XXH128_hash_t values.

functions.name: XXH128_cmp
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF int XXH128_cmp(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* h128_1, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* h128_2);
functions.description: Comparator compatible with qsort()/bsearch() for XXH128_hash_t. Interprets pointers as pointers to XXH128_hash_t and compares lexicographically (high64 then low64).
requirements: h128_1 and h128_2 must be non-NULL pointers to XXH128_hash_t.
Return semantics: >0 if left > right, 0 if equal, <0 if left < right.

functions.name: XXH128_canonicalFromHash
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH128_canonicalFromHash(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH128_canonical_t* dst, XXH128_hash_t hash);
functions.description: Converts a native XXH128_hash_t to its big-endian canonical byte representation for storage or transmission.
requirements: dst must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH128_hashFromCanonical
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH128_hashFromCanonical(XXH_NOESCAPE const XXH128_canonical_t* src);
functions.description: Converts a big-endian canonical XXH128_canonical_t back to native XXH128_hash_t.
requirements: src must not be NULL.

functions.name: XXH128
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH128(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* data, size_t len, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Convenience wrapper returning the 128-bit XXH3 hash with a 64-bit seed (equivalent to XXH3_128bits_withSeed).
requirements: If len == 0, data may be NULL; otherwise [data, data+len) must be valid and readable.
In C++, the input range must be TriviallyCopyable.

functions.name: XXH3_generateSecret
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_generateSecret(XXH_NOESCAPE void* secretBuffer, size_t secretSize, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* customSeed, size_t customSeedSize);
functions.description: Derives a high-entropy secret of length secretSize into secretBuffer from arbitrary user-provided customSeed bytes. Intended for use with *_withSecret and *_withSecretandSeed variants.
requirements: secretBuffer must not be NULL and must be writable.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).
If customSeedSize == 0, a built-in default secret is used; otherwise customSeed must not be NULL.
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH3_generateSecret_fromSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API void XXH3_generateSecret_fromSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE void* secretBuffer, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Generates the same secret material used by the *_withSeed() variants into secretBuffer (XXH3_SECRET_DEFAULT_SIZE bytes) from a 64-bit seed, for reuse with *_withSecret or *_withSecretandSeed.
requirements: secretBuffer must point to a writable buffer of size XXH3_SECRET_DEFAULT_SIZE (192 bytes).

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_withSecretandSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH64_hash_t XXH3_64bits_withSecretandSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* data, size_t len, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize, XXH64_hash_t seed);
functions.description: Single-shot XXH3 64-bit hash combining a custom secret (for large inputs) and a seed (for small inputs) for best performance. If secret was generated by XXH3_generateSecret_fromSeed with the same seed, results match *_withSeed for large inputs.
requirements: [data, data+len) must be valid and readable (or data may be NULL if len == 0).
secret must not be NULL and should have high entropy; secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_withSecretandSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH128_hash_t XXH3_128bits_withSecretandSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE const void* input, size_t length, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize, XXH64_hash_t seed64);
functions.description: Single-shot XXH3 128-bit hash combining a custom secret and a seed as in the 64-bit variant.
requirements: [input, input+length) must be valid and readable (or input may be NULL if length == 0).
secret must not be NULL and should have high entropy; secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).

functions.name: XXH3_64bits_reset_withSecretandSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_64bits_reset_withSecretandSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize, XXH64_hash_t seed64);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 64-bit hashing using both a secret and a seed (see *_withSecretandSeed).
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
secret must not be NULL; secret must outlive the streaming session.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

functions.name: XXH3_128bits_reset_withSecretandSeed
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH3_128bits_reset_withSecretandSeed(XXH_NOESCAPE XXH3_state_t* statePtr, XXH_NOESCAPE const void* secret, size_t secretSize, XXH64_hash_t seed64);
functions.description: Resets an XXH3 streaming state for 128-bit hashing using both a secret and a seed (see *_withSecretandSeed). Note: Versions <= v0.8.2 had a bug affecting a corner case; results from those buggy versions are not comparable in that case.
requirements: statePtr must not be NULL.
secret must not be NULL; secret must outlive the streaming session.
secretSize must be >= XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136).
Returns XXH_OK on success, XXH_ERROR on failure.

data_types.description: A byte buffer of any content and length, including zero-length. May contain arbitrary non-text bytes. Used as the input block hashed by XXH32/XXH64/XXH3 functions or as customSeed bytes. Provided via FUZZ_PARAM_STR and passed as pointer+length to functions expecting raw data.

A byte buffer acting as XXH3 secret material. Must be at least 136 bytes long and ideally contain high entropy (unstructured) data. Provided by fuzzer by filling an allocated buffer from fuzzed bytes and passed to *_withSecret, *_reset_withSecret, or *_withSecretandSeed APIs.

import random
import struct
import itertools

# This generator produces arbitrary binary data suitable for the various FUZZ_PARAM_STR
# sites in the provided xxHash fuzzers. It focuses on creating valid, interesting inputs
# across typical edge sizes and content patterns, including zero-length, small, medium,
# and larger buffers, as well as structured and high-entropy data. All outputs are <= 4096 bytes.

_MAX_SIZE = 4096

# Some curated blocks to exercise algorithm paths (short/small/medium/large, repeated patterns, etc.)
_FIXED_BLOCKS = [
    b"",                                  # zero-length
    b"\x00",                               # single NUL
    b"A",                                  # single ASCII
    b"\xff",                               # single 0xFF
    b"hello",                             # small word
    b"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog",  # pangram
    b"\x00" * 16,                          # zeros 16
    b"\xff" * 32,                          # 0xFF 32
    b"\x00\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06\x07" * 4,  # ascending pattern
    b"ABCD" * 8,                           # repeating 4B pattern
    bytes(range(64)),                      # 0..63
    (bytes(range(256)) * 4)[:512],         # 512 bytes cycling 0..255
]

# Sizes that often hit special-case code paths in xxHash family
_INTERESTING_SIZES = [
    0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 12, 15, 16, 17, 24, 31, 32, 33, 63, 64, 65,
    127, 128, 129, 135, 136, 191, 192, 255, 256, 257, 511, 512, 1023,
    1024, 2048, 3072, 4095, 4096
]

def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return rng.randbytes(n) if hasattr(rng, 'randbytes') else bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))

def _pattern_fill(pattern: bytes, size: int) -> bytes:
    if size <= 0:
        return b""
    rep, rem = divmod(size, len(pattern))
    return pattern * rep + pattern[:rem]

def _make_secret_like(rng: random.Random, size: int) -> bytes:
    # Create a high-entropy secret-like buffer (size >= 136 used by secret-based APIs)
    # Mix random, pattern, and structured chunks to ensure non-trivial content.
    chunks = []
    remaining = size
    # Start with random
    first = min(64, remaining)
    chunks.append(_rand_bytes(rng, first))
    remaining -= first
    # Add patterned cycles
    patterns = [
        bytes(range(256)),
        b"\x00\xff" * 64,
        b"S3CR3T-" * 32,
        struct.pack("<QQQQ", rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64)),
    ]
    it = itertools.cycle(patterns)
    while remaining > 0:
        pat = next(it)
        take = min(len(pat), remaining)
        chunks.append(pat[:take])
        remaining -= take
    return b"".join(chunks)

def _compose(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Choose a strategy
    strat = rng.randrange(0, 10)

    if strat == 0:
        # Pick from fixed blocks
        return rng.choice(_FIXED_BLOCKS)

    if strat == 1:
        # Pick a fixed block then pad/trim to an interesting size
        base = rng.choice(_FIXED_BLOCKS)
        size = rng.choice(_INTERESTING_SIZES)
        if size <= len(base):
            return base[:size]
        else:
            pad = _pattern_fill(base if base else b"\xAA", size - len(base))
            return base + pad

    if strat == 2:
        # Pure random of interesting size
        size = rng.choice(_INTERESTING_SIZES)
        return _rand_bytes(rng, min(size, _MAX_SIZE))

    if strat == 3:
        # Repeating short motif to hit repeated-pattern paths
        motifs = [b"A", b"\x00", b"\xff", b"AB", b"\x00\x01", b"abcd", b"\x10\x20\x30\x40"]
        motif = rng.choice(motifs)
        size = rng.choice(_INTERESTING_SIZES)
        return _pattern_fill(motif, min(size, _MAX_SIZE))

    if strat == 4:
        # Structured header + payload
        size = rng.choice(_INTERESTING_SIZES)
        size = min(size, _MAX_SIZE)
        header = struct.pack(
            "<IQQ",
            rng.getrandbits(32),
            rng.getrandbits(64),
            rng.getrandbits(64),
        )
        payload_len = max(0, size - len(header))
        payload = _rand_bytes(rng, payload_len)
        return (header + payload)[:size]

    if strat == 5:
        # Mix of zeroes, ff, ascending, and random blocks
        parts = []
        for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 6)):
            choice = rng.randrange(0, 4)
            blen = rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 13, 16, 31, 32, 63, 64, 127, 128, 191, 192])
            if choice == 0:
                parts.append(b"\x00" * blen)
            elif choice == 1:
                parts.append(b"\xff" * blen)
            elif choice == 2:
                asc = bytes(range(256))
                parts.append(_pattern_fill(asc, blen))
            else:
                parts.append(_rand_bytes(rng, blen))
        out = b"".join(parts)
        return out[:_MAX_SIZE]

    if strat == 6:
        # Secret-like buffer with size >= 136 (still valid for general data inputs)
        size = rng.choice([136, 192, 256, 384, 512, 1024, 2048])
        return _make_secret_like(rng, min(size, _MAX_SIZE))

    if strat == 7:
        # Length deliberately chosen around XXH3 small/large internal thresholds (e.g., 16, 128, 240)
        size = rng.choice([15, 16, 17, 127, 128, 129, 239, 240, 241, 511])
        size = min(size, _MAX_SIZE)
        # Content: half random, half repeating pattern
        half = size // 2
        return _rand_bytes(rng, half) + _pattern_fill(b"\xA5", size - half)

    if strat == 8:
        # UTF-8-ish text payload with varied lengths
        texts = [
            "",
            "\u2603",  # snowman
            "lorem ipsum dolor sit amet",
            "漢字カタカナひらがな",
            "emoji: 😀😃😄😁😆😅😂🤣😊😇",
            "nulls\x00inside and t\tbs and newlines\n",
        ]
        s = rng.choice(texts)
        raw = s.encode('utf-8', 'ignore')
        size = rng.choice(_INTERESTING_SIZES)
        if size <= len(raw):
            return raw[:size]
        return raw + _rand_bytes(rng, min(_MAX_SIZE - len(raw), size - len(raw)))

    # strat == 9
    # Concatenate several sub-buffers of different nature up to a cap
    out = bytearray()
    target = rng.choice([64, 128, 192, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096])
    while len(out) < target:
        sub = _compose(rng)
        take = min(len(sub), target - len(out))
        out.extend(sub[:take])
        if len(out) >= _MAX_SIZE:
            break
    return bytes(out[:_MAX_SIZE])


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Bias towards occasionally returning empty buffers to exercise len==0 paths.
    if rng.random() < 0.10:
        return b""
    data = _compose(rng)
    # Ensure final size cap
    return data[:_MAX_SIZE]

import os
import random
import struct
import itertools

# Generator for XXH3 secret/data inputs.
# The fuzzer stubs consume several FUZZ_PARAM_* in this order per invocation, roughly:
# - unsigned int (for secretSize range)
# - std::string seedBytes/secBytes (used to fill the secret bytes, cycled)
# - std::string buf (data buffer)
# - unsigned int chooser (to decide len==0 vs full buf)
# - optionally XXH64_hash_t seed (8 bytes) for *withSecretandSeed or reset_withSecretandSeed variants
#
# Our buffer layout encodes a sequence of such parameter blocks so that any stub
# can read values it needs in-order. We keep everything valid:
# - secretSize in [136, 512]
# - seed string non-empty so secret filling is non-trivial
# - data string may be empty or non-empty depending on chooser
# - chooser toggles between 0/1 to cover both NULL-data and non-NULL paths
# - seeds are 64-bit values with different patterns
#
# Binary format (little endian for ints/seeds):
#   repeat N blocks, concatenated, where each block is:
#     u32    secretSize_hint (we map into [136,512] via modulo in stub)
#     u32    seedStrLen
#     bytes  seedStrLen bytes (non-zero length)
#     u32    dataLen
#     bytes  dataLen bytes
#     u32    chooser
#     u64    seed64
# N is implicit; the fuzzer runtime will just keep pulling params.
# We cap total size <= 4096.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

ALPHAS = b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = b"0123456789"
PUNCT  = b"!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{};:'\",.<>/?`~|\\"
WHITES = b" \t\r\n\x0b\x0c"
ALL_BYTES = bytes(range(256))


def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, length: int, high_entropy: bool = True) -> bytes:
    if length <= 0:
        return b""
    # Mix patterns with random to create valid, diverse content
    choice = rng.randrange(6) if high_entropy else 0
    if choice == 0:
        # pure random
        return rng.randbytes(length)
    if choice == 1:
        # repeated small motif
        motif_len = rng.randint(1, min(32, length))
        motif = rng.randbytes(motif_len)
        return (motif * (length // motif_len + 1))[:length]
    if choice == 2:
        # ASCII letters/digits
        pool = ALPHAS + DIGITS
        return bytes(rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(length))
    if choice == 3:
        # alternating ranges
        pools = [ALPHAS, DIGITS, PUNCT, WHITES]
        out = bytearray(length)
        for i in range(length):
            pool = pools[i % len(pools)]
            out[i] = pool[rng.randrange(len(pool))]
        return bytes(out)
    if choice == 4:
        # incremental bytes with wrap
        start = rng.randrange(256)
        return bytes((start + i) & 0xFF for i in range(length))
    # choice == 5: slice of all-bytes repeated
    rep = (ALL_BYTES * ((length // 256) + 1))[:length]
    # rotate by random offset
    off = rng.randrange(len(rep)) if rep else 0
    return rep[off:] + rep[:off]


def _mk_seed_string(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Ensure non-empty, varied content to avoid trivial secrets
    length = rng.randint(8, 128)
    return _rand_bytes(rng, length, high_entropy=True)


def _mk_data_buffer(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Vary data sizes: empty, tiny, medium, large (bounded)
    bucket = rng.randrange(6)
    if bucket == 0:
        size = 0
    elif bucket == 1:
        size = rng.randint(1, 15)
    elif bucket == 2:
        size = rng.randint(16, 64)
    elif bucket == 3:
        size = rng.randint(65, 255)
    elif bucket == 4:
        size = rng.randint(256, 1024)
    else:
        size = rng.randint(1025, 2048)
    return _rand_bytes(rng, size, high_entropy=True)


def _mk_secret_size_hint(rng: random.Random) -> int:
    # The stub maps this via modulo into [136,512]. Any value is acceptable;
    # we choose values that, after modulo, exercise boundaries too.
    # We'll craft hints so that modulo produces sizes near 136, 192, 256, 511, 512.
    # Since secretSize = 136 + (hint % 377) (because 512-136+1 = 377)
    targets = [136, 192, 256, 511, 512]
    t = rng.choice(targets)
    # Find an x such that 136 + (x % 377) == t -> x % 377 == (t - 136)
    rem = (t - 136) % 377
    base = rng.randrange(0, 1 << 16) // 377 * 377  # multiple of 377
    return base + rem


def _mk_chooser(rng: random.Random) -> int:
    # Alternate evenly between even/odd to toggle len==0 path in stubs
    return rng.randrange(0, 2)


def _mk_seed64(rng: random.Random) -> int:
    # Provide diverse seeds: random, zeros, all-ones, edge patterns.
    patterns = [
        0,
        0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF,
        0x00000000FFFFFFFF,
        0xFFFFFFFF00000000,
        0x5555555555555555,
        0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA,
    ]
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        return rng.getrandbits(64)
    else:
        return rng.choice(patterns)


def _pack_block(secret_hint: int, seed_bytes: bytes, data_bytes: bytes, chooser: int, seed64: int) -> bytes:
    parts = []
    parts.append(struct.pack('<I', secret_hint & 0xFFFFFFFF))
    parts.append(struct.pack('<I', len(seed_bytes)))
    parts.append(seed_bytes)
    parts.append(struct.pack('<I', len(data_bytes)))
    parts.append(data_bytes)
    parts.append(struct.pack('<I', chooser & 0xFFFFFFFF))
    parts.append(struct.pack('<Q', seed64 & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF))
    return b''.join(parts)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    blocks = []

    # Decide how many blocks to emit so total <= 4096
    # Start with a target between 3 and 8 blocks, adjust if size would exceed cap
    target_blocks = rng.randint(3, 8)

    while len(blocks) < target_blocks:
        secret_hint = _mk_secret_size_hint(rng)
        seed_bytes = _mk_seed_string(rng)
        data_bytes = _mk_data_buffer(rng)
        chooser = _mk_chooser(rng)
        # If chooser indicates len==0 for a given stub, data may be ignored; still fine.
        seed64 = _mk_seed64(rng)
        blk = _pack_block(secret_hint, seed_bytes, data_bytes, chooser, seed64)
        if sum(len(b) for b in blocks) + len(blk) > MAX_TOTAL:
            break
        blocks.append(blk)

    if not blocks:
        # Fallback minimal valid block
        secret_hint = _mk_secret_size_hint(rng)
        seed_bytes = _mk_seed_string(rng)
        data_bytes = b""
        chooser = 0
        seed64 = 0
        blocks.append(_pack_block(secret_hint, seed_bytes, data_bytes, chooser, seed64))

    return b''.join(blocks)
